evidence.reason: At lines 714-715, the launch record is written before the protected block starts at line 716. If Recorder.append() raises, boot() bypasses its except/finally cleanup, leaving the already-spawned subprocess unreaped and qemu.log unclosed; caller cleanup may race the scope registration and allow the child to start QEMU after the CLI exits. This is a concrete correctness defect in existing intended boot behavior, not a request to add new protection scope. The smallest compatible fix is to include the record write in the protected path and retain the terminate/reap cleanup on failure.
